title: Unique Paths
contract: Count paths through an rows × cols grid moving only right or down. Both dimensions are positive and the result fits long.
optimal: long[] dp=new long[cols];Arrays.fill(dp,1);for(int r=1;r<rows;r++)for(int c=1;c<cols;c++){dp[c]+=dp[c-1];emit("Paths from above plus paths from the left","cell",new int[]{r,c},"row",dp);}return dp[cols-1];
reasoning: The final move into a cell comes from above or the left; recursive branching enumerates these choices repeatedly.
The top row and leftmost column each have exactly one path.
In a rolling row, dp[c] still stores the value from above while dp[c−1] already stores the current-row left value. Left-to-right iteration is essential.
